description:
Test build, not a release. For stable builds use main/bundles/stable.json.

- Inline media: bare image and video links (just a URL) are replaced by the media. New settings "Hide bare image links" and "Hide bare video links" (on) turn this off.
- Inline media: new "Video progress bar" (on): a thin bar along the bottom of playing inline videos while their controls are hidden.
- Includes 1.10.1-dev7.
